title: feat(dfk1): deep-out-face same-k holds at k=1: t=3 vs t=5
science: deep-out-face df = rho3 + out-face restricted to source max >= 2. The note gives the reason the restriction is free: the unit-out hop (1,1,0)->(2,1,0) that df skips is already priced 3 by mu, so df and omega differ as predicates but agree as costs. B_6: 3 vs 5, holds.
